sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Blocks usage statistics sent to imo, AppsFlyer, Firebase and Facebook, and the advertising ID upload.
Removes the forced update screen and the update prompts.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes splash, chat list, story and end-of-call ads, and skips the ad consent form.
Hides the invite friends dialog, the invite entry in the chat list and the call sharing banner.
Removes the Voice Club tab from the home screen.
Stops chats and calls from reporting screenshots and screen recordings to the other person.
Raises the limit on photos, videos and files sent at once to 100.
Allows copying, sharing, forwarding and downloading messages in chats with chat privacy or Time Machine turned on.
Raises the limit on contacts selected for iBubble close friends and Family Guard invites to 999. Experimental.
Allows forwarding disappearing and view-once text messages.
Allows screenshots and screen recording in chats, calls, media and profiles.
Removes the length limit on story videos picked from the gallery or recorded.
Opens profile photos in full size when their owner restricts it.
Restores phone verification by call when signing in.
